# Skill library repository

- Treat `.github/skills` as the canonical skill source.
- Keep every skill in its own folder with an uppercase `SKILL.md` and valid Agent Skills front matter.
- Preserve executable assets beside the skill that uses them.
- Review skill changes through pull requests; a merge to `main` creates a new immutable Foundry version.
- Never place tokens, client secrets, customer data, or generated skill archives in the repository.
- Keep API Center metadata, Foundry skill content, and runtime catalog descriptions aligned.
